name: Next Station is...
summary:
Next Station is... is a first-person psychological horror and anomaly-detection game set aboard a subway train during its final service of the night.

As the train's driver, players must inspect each station for unusual occurrences before deciding whether to open the doors or bypass the platform. Using the driver's cabin window and CCTV cameras installed throughout the train, players must identify anomalies hidden among seemingly ordinary passengers and environments.

Each decision affects the journey. Opening the doors at an anomalous station may allow unwanted passengers or entities to board the train, carrying the consequences into subsequent stations. Players must make their decisions before the station timer expires, as failing to act causes the doors to open automatically.

Featuring PSX-inspired visuals, environmental observation, surveillance mechanics, and psychological horror elements, Next Station is... focuses on identifying subtle abnormalities while navigating an increasingly unsettling subway route.
